name: helix
description: Visual surfaces and shared infrastructure for Claude Code: Start (routing a job to its surface), Spark (diverging), Canvas (deciding), Loop (building against a ratified bar), Arena (one question answered N times and judged), Swarm (one job cut into slices and merged), Stream (watching autonomous work), Archive (a session's story, kept read-only), Fleet (mission control), Memory (what we know), Vault (secrets agents never read), Rails (rules, standards and playbooks that bind), Shelf (artefacts kept once, referenced from any session).
